lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Hello, main Kaveri Finance se bol raha hoon. Kya Sunita Sharma ji baat kar rahi hain?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: हाँ, मैं Sunita बोल रही हूँ। बोलिए, क्या काम है?
lines.roman: Haan, main Sunita bol rahi hoon. Boliye, kya kaam hai?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Ma'am, aapke two-wheeler loan ki EMI, four thousand two hundred rupees, jo tenth November ko due thi, abhi tak pending hai.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: हाँ पता है, पर अभी मैं office में हूँ, मुझे meeting में जाना है।
lines.roman: Haan pata hai, par abhi main office mein hoon, mujhe meeting mein jaana hai.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Ma'am bas do minute lagenge. Payment kyun nahi ho paya tha is baar?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: मेरे husband पिछले हफ्ते hospital में admit थे, सारा पैसा वहीं लग गया।
lines.roman: Mere husband pichhle hafte hospital mein admit the, saara paisa wahin lag gaya.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Achha. Toh EMI kab tak kar dengi aap?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: अभी पक्का नहीं बता सकती। पहले hospital के bills settle होने दीजिए, फिर देखती हूँ।
lines.roman: Abhi pakka nahi bata sakti. Pehle hospital ke bills settle hone dijiye, phir dekhti hoon.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Ma'am, late payment se aapka CIBIL score affect hoga aur penalty bhi lagegi, isliye jaldi kar dijiye.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: समझ गई। आप शाम को call कर लीजिए, तब घर पर आराम से बात करती हूँ।
lines.roman: Samajh gayi. Aap shaam ko call kar lijiye, tab ghar par aaram se baat karti hoon.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Theek hai ma'am, kitne baje call karun?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: छह बजे के बाद कर लीजिए।
lines.roman: Chhe baje ke baad kar lijiye.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Okay ma'am, toh main aaj six PM ke baad call karta hoon. Tab tak ho sake toh UPI se payment kar dijiye.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer was busy at work and asked to be called back after 6 PM without committing to an amount or date.
analysis.summary: Borrower missed the November two-wheeler EMI of ₹4,200 after her husband's hospitalisation. Agent stated dues and asked the reason, but did not acknowledge the hardship and ended with only a callback.
analysis.observations: Basics were covered (company named, dues and due date stated, reason asked), but the recording disclosure was skipped and the agent moved straight from a medical emergency to 'kab tak kar dengi'. The late-fee line was vague rather than quantified.
analysis.improvements: Acknowledge medical hardship before asking for a date; disclose call recording at the start; quote the actual late fee; try for a tentative PTP date even when scheduling a callback.

op_greet_company.rationale: Greeted and named Kaveri Finance in the opening line.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Confirmed the borrower's name before discussing the loan; no account or DOB check.

op_recording_disclosure.rationale: No mention that the call is recorded.

pr_state_dues.rationale: Stated ₹4,200 EMI and the 10 November due date.

pr_late_fee_info.rationale: Mentioned CIBIL impact and penalty without threats, though the fee amount was not given.

ds_reason_delay.rationale: Directly asked why the payment was missed.

ds_empathy.rationale: Moved straight to 'kab tak kar dengi' after hearing about the husband's hospitalisation.

cp_respectful.rationale: Polite throughout, if a little rushed.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: Loan discussed only with the confirmed borrower.

cl_ptp_secured.rationale: Customer would not commit to a date; no PTP obtained.

cl_payment_mode.rationale: UPI was suggested but the customer never confirmed a payment mode.

cl_recap.rationale: Agent confirmed the callback time before ending.
